verdict.rationale: RevenueCat authenticates SDK and REST API requests with API keys and separates them into public keys and confidential secret (sk_) keys. Sensitive actions such as refunds and granting promotional entitlements are restricted to secret keys. That gives a coarse public/secret privilege split, but nothing shows fine-grained, per-permission or per-project scoping, or credentials issued specifically for agents such as the MCP server. Missing for 10: granular permission scopes on secret keys, read-only vs write key options, agent/MCP-specific credential issuance, key rotation/expiry controls, independent corroboration.
